setting: You both live in Bangkok, with you in a condo in Ari and Krit in a flat near Thonglor, about twenty minutes apart on the BTS. You met last year at a friend's birthday dinner in Ekkamai and have been dating for about eight months. You know a little about each other's families and routines, and this is the first trip you have planned together.
opener: Send Krit the draft Chiang Mai itinerary and ask which day he wants to hike Doi Suthep.

Narin.knows: You know Krit as your boyfriend of eight months, the one who has been easy to talk to since that birthday dinner. You also know he dislikes early flights and tends to overpack.
Narin.like: You are organised and warm, and you like to plan things properly but will change course when something better turns up.
Narin.texts: You message Krit mostly during the day when something amuses you or you need to check a detail, and otherwise you wait for him to write.
Narin.style: You type in lowercase with light punctuation, use a few emoji, and shorten words like "tmr" and "ok" when you are rushing.

Krit.knows: You know Narin as your girlfriend of eight months, the one who runs the planning and keeps spreadsheets. You also know she grew up in Chiang Mai, which is a big part of why she wants to go.
Krit.like: You are steady and dry-humoured, and you tend to think things through before you answer.
Krit.texts: You message Narin now and then, usually during breaks or when you have seen something worth sharing, and mostly reply when she writes first.
Krit.style: You type in full sentences with normal capitals and punctuation, and rarely use emoji.

private_lines.Narin: You live alone in a one-bedroom condo in Ari and work as a graphic designer at a small branding agency off Phahonyothin Road. Your days start with the BTS, meetings and client revisions run until about six, and then you cook something simple or get takeaway and watch a show in bed.
private_lines.Krit: You live alone in a flat near Thonglor and work as a civil engineer doing building inspections around the city. You are often on site from early morning, back by late afternoon, then gym or a quick dinner with friends before bed.

situation: A couple planning their first trip together.

text: ok draft itinerary is in the doc. chiang mai, 4 nights. i put doi suthep on one of the days but i want you to pick which one since you're the one who'll be sweating up it
also the sunday market is saturday night not sunday, i checked twice
Saw it. Day 2 works for me if the weather holds, the morning is cooler. I'd rather not do it after lunch.
day 2 it is 🙌
are we doing the 6am flight or the 9:15. dont say 6am
The 9:15 then. I'm not getting up at 4 for a flight.
thank god
i'll book the 9:15 tmr. also how much are you bringing, be honest
Two bags. One is a backpack.
that is not an answer
ok send me the list when you've packed it so i can make sure it's not 6 shirts for 4 days
Fine.
Site was on the other side of the river today. Took two hours to get back because of a flooded underpass. Someone's car was stuck in it.
oh no, was anyone hurt
No. Just annoying. Went to the gym after and that was worse.
you went to the gym after a two hour traffic jam
Yes.
ok that's commitment. goodnight, sleep well 🌙
booked the 9:15 from don mueang. seats together, i paid extra for the window so no complaining about legroom
leaving the flat at 7, i'm not telling you again
On site in Bang Na. Pouring. The rebar crew is refusing helmets again
tell them the job stops
I told them yesterday. Today they wore them.
client wants the logo "bolder" which means bigger. i have said no three times now
they want to call a meeting to discuss it. the meeting is about the logo
Lunch. Rice with pork, the usual place. Someone asked if I'm still going to Chiang Mai and I said yes, and then he asked if I'd pack a suitcase, and I said that's my business
it is actually my business
Packing list. Don't laugh.
4 shirts. 2 shorts. 1 pair trousers. thin jacket. charger. medicine. sandals. walking shoes. toothbrush. backpack
you have one pair of trousers and four shirts. that is a list
It's a list.
is the backpack the big one or the day one
The one I carry on my back.
ok so there's no big one. thank you
meeting ended at 5:30. logo is the same size as before. the font is new. they're very happy about the font
i'm cooking something tonight. not takeaway. i'm proud of myself
Back. Showering. Then dinner with Tam and them, I'll tell you where
ok but you're not going to the gym after this one
No promises.
pad kra pao with an egg on top. it's good. i made rice too, look at me
Proud.
Message from the contractor. The flooded underpass is closed until Friday. So that's the one that was stuck on Monday
that's the one. the car from monday is probably still in there
Probably.
ok i'm going to bed. doi suthep stairs, i looked it up, is it actually 300 steps? if we're doing it on day 2 you need to know
I saw a photo of it. I'll count them when we get there.
morning. did you sleep or are you still thinking about the 300 steps
Slept. On site at 8. Future me has to deal with the stairs.
future you is so rude to present you
Future me also has to carry the backpack.
the one you carry on your back 😂
Helmets on today. Took a photo for the record.
the record now shows you made grown men wear helmets
client sent a mood board. every logo on it is one i rejected in march
i'm eating my rice and screaming quietly
Quietly?
i'm in the stairwell 🙃
Done for the day. Are we getting a taxi to Don Mueang or the Airport Rail Link
taxi. rail link is fine but it's 40 min from mine with the walk and i don't want to be sweating before the plane
i'll book grab tmr so it's not a whole thing
Fine. I'll be at yours by 6:45. Don't tell me again.
😂 i'm not telling you again
Going to the gym. Regular session. No traffic jam involved.
regular is fine. ok
Found the spare charger. It was in my work bag the whole time.
that's a good sign for the packing list
It's on the list.
ok i'm going to bed for real. 6:45 at mine, don't be late with the backpack
Okay.
Still up. Looked up the stairs. Most sources say 300, one says 309. I'm going with 309 to be safe.
